details:
A minor accessibility annoyance. The page reads "list, [n] items" three times for release notes due to list discontinuities, which seem to be unintended.

Expressed in Markdown:

```

- "Filter Extreme Horror" is no longer cut off at the bottom of the Comfort and Safety settings.

- The "typing" indicator is once again visible in red for users who's full chatbox you have hidden.

 

- The HUD Face Mirror should no longer appear as a black square on the loading screen.

```

This causes the two lists above to become separated and discontinued from each other, forming two `<ul>` elements in HTML output. This can disrupt a non-visual reader with navigation or interrupt reading the release notes with reading out "list, [n] items" repeatedly.

I expected there should be no newline in between, and there to be one unordered list `<ul>` element on the page.

In Markdown, the above is expected to be:

```

- "Filter Extreme Horror" is no longer cut off at the bottom of the Comfort and Safety settings.

- The "typing" indicator is once again visible in red for users who's full chatbox you have hidden.

- The HUD Face Mirror should no longer appear as a black square on the loading screen.

```

It also occurs right before:

```

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Customize Action Menu" page to open for looks when associated data didn't properly load.

```
title: VRChat 2026.4.1 release notes: Unexpected discontinuities in unordered lists
